description:
Engel & Völkers, the global platform for premium residential and commercial real estate, brings bespoke property search directly into your ChatGPT conversations. Discover exclusive apartments, historic villas, and prime investment properties using natural language, no tedious forms, just seamless conversation.

Explore high-end listings with stunning imagery, interactive maps, and detailed pricing right in the chat. View your curated results as a sleek carousel or see properties pinned on a map to evaluate premium neighborhoods at a glance.

Try asking things like:
- Show me 3-bedroom apartments for rent in Berlin
- Find me houses to buy in Paris with a garden
- I'm looking for a penthouse with a sea view in Barcelona
- Show me premium houses in Rome

From price ranges and room counts to specific premium features and elite neighborhoods, Engel & Völkers makes discovering exceptional properties simple, all through first-class, natural conversation.

defaultPrompt: Find me an apartment to buy in Hamburg
